{{Top|leg}}
A '''Regional Naval Supply Area''', or '''RNSA''', was a supply and storage facilities for arms, ammunition, and other supplies. Security was usually extremely tight with the highest enforcement in clearance.

The RNSA at [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] was infiltrated and a load of explosives went triggered and sent out with the hopes for reaching the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. As the ''[[Undauntable]]'' needed ammunition before the Death Star, the containers were shipped there instead, and the ship exploded.

[[Natasi Daala|Daala]] and [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] focused on the RNSA at Gall to find any Rebel spies that might have been hiding in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
